desc.en: Spa is a municipality and city of Wallonia in the province of Liège, Belgium, whose name became an eponym for mineral baths with supposed curative properties.
desc.es: Spa es una ciudad ubicada en la provincia de Lieja, en Bélgica.

places.name: Atomium

desc.en: The Atomium is a landmark modernist building in Brussels, Belgium, originally constructed as the centrepiece of the 1958 Brussels World's Fair.
desc.es: El Atomium es un monumento moderno ubicado en Bruselas (Bélgica), construido originalmente como la pieza central de la Exposición Universal de Bruselas de 1958.

desc.en: The Cathedral of Our Lady is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Antwerp, Belgium.

desc.en: The Church of Our Lady is a Roman Catholic church in Bruges, Belgium, dating mainly from the 13th, 14th and 15th centuries.
desc.es: La Iglesia de Nuestra Señora, en Brujas, Bélgica, es una gran iglesia medieval que data principalmente de los siglos XIII, XIV y XV.
